terms.serviceBody: SOM (Brand Operating System) is a content operations platform for managers and agencies. By subscribing, you agree to use the service under these terms.
terms.billingBody: Subscriptions are monthly and billed by Stripe on the card you provide at checkout. Prices, limits, and what each plan includes are on the home page and in your profile — not in this document.
terms.cancelBody: You can cancel anytime in the billing portal (Manage subscription, in your profile). Access continues until the end of the paid period. There is no prorated refund for the current period unless required by law.
terms.lateBody: If the card is declined, there is a 3-day grace period. After that, manager access may be suspended until billing is brought up to date.
terms.limitsBody: Clients, team seats, and features (library, briefing, design AI, and others) follow the contracted plan. Going over the limit is rejected in the product. Plan comparison lives on the landing page and in your profile.
terms.dataBody: Content, files, and client data belong to you. SOM processes them only to provide the service. End clients only access the workspace they were invited to.
terms.aiBody: AI features use your saved key first (BYOK). Without your own key, there may be a limited daily platform quota. We are not responsible for how you use generated copy and artwork, or for costs on your own key. What the AI uses as context — and what it cannot see — is described in Features and limits.
terms.accountBody: We may close accounts for abuse, persistent non-payment, or breach of these terms.

privacy.collectBody: We collect name, email, billing data (via Stripe), and the content you and your clients upload (copy, media, comments).
privacy.useBody: We use this data to authenticate, provide the service, bill the subscription, and improve the product. We do not sell personal data.
privacy.providersBody: Payments are processed by Stripe. AI providers (platform quota or your own key) receive the text or image needed to generate a response, with no extra right to train on your content beyond their own terms.
privacy.deleteBody: You can request account and data deletion via support email. End clients only access the workspace they were invited to.

legal.resourcesLead: SOM runs the brand: briefing, guide, calendar, approval, and copy. It does not replace Instagram. AI writes from what the team saves — it does not read the feed, pull Meta insights, or edit video. Publishing means downloading the file and copying the caption.
legal.resourcesSeeAlso: What the AI generates and what it cannot see is described in

does.opsBody: Clients, projects, briefing, guide, calendar, approval, meetings, and library in one place.
does.copyBody: Captions, CTAs, hashtags, and voiceover as HOOK / BODY / CTA, with a chat to refine the text.
does.ideasBody: A batch with a funnel mix (TOFU / MOFU / BOFU) from the guide, themes, and saved references.
does.linksBody: YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok: title and public metadata only. The AI does not watch the video.
does.webBody: Public snippets from open search to support the brief. It does not enter Instagram.
does.learningBody: The team notes reach, retention, and what to repeat. That becomes context — not automatic model training.
does.publishBody: Download the media and copy the caption. SOM does not post to the social account.

doesNot.replaceTitle: It does not replace the networks
doesNot.replaceBody: It is not Instagram, TikTok, or Meta Business. It is the agency operating system.
doesNot.feedTitle: It does not read the profile feed
doesNot.feedBody: Saving an @ or a profile URL does not open the grid of posts.
doesNot.insightsTitle: It does not pull Meta insights
doesNot.insightsBody: No account OAuth and no Graph API. Metrics only appear if the team types them.
doesNot.trainTitle: It does not train its own model
doesNot.trainBody: Generating copy does not teach the AI. Voice comes from the guide, notes, and formats you mark to repeat.
doesNot.videoBody: No cuts, burned-in captions, or timeline. SOM writes the voiceover and script.
doesNot.autoPostBody: It does not log into the account or fire the post. You publish on the network.
doesNot.viralBody: Ideas come from what is saved for the brand, not from thousands of other people's posts.
doesNot.guaranteeBody: No promise of virality or media results. Operations and review stay with you.

legal.contextTitle: Where the AI gets the brand voice
legal.contextLead: On each generation, SOM builds context from what is already in the project. None of this trains a model in the background.

context.briefing: Briefing, brand guide, themes, and copy already saved on the content.
context.notes: Team notes on reference creators (what to borrow and what to avoid).
context.links: Title and author of a public post, if you paste the URL — plus any transcript you paste.
context.repeat: Posts the team marked to repeat, with the performance note.
context.search: Web search only if that option is on for that request.

faq.learnQ: Does the AI learn brand voice on its own as we generate content?
faq.learnA: No. Each generation uses the briefing, guide, notes, and what you marked to repeat. The OpenAI or Gemini model is not trained on the brand history. If the guide is empty, the copy stays generic.
faq.instagramQ: If I save an Instagram profile, does SOM analyze the feed?
faq.instagramA: No. With a public post or reel URL, we read title and author (oEmbed metadata). The rest comes from team notes. No Meta login, no post list, no account metrics.
faq.webA: No. It is open web search. It does not scrape the social network. It supports the brief; it does not replace the client's feed.
faq.publishQ: How does content get to Instagram?
faq.publishA: You download the file, copy the caption, and publish on the network. SOM does not connect the account or fire the post.
faq.videoQ: Is there a video editor, burned-in captions, or a timeline?
faq.videoA: No. That is a different product. SOM writes the voiceover (HOOK / BODY / CTA) and the script. File editing stays outside the platform.
faq.insightsQ: Where do performance numbers come from?
faq.insightsA: Only from what the team types after publishing (reach, retention, note). We do not sync Instagram Insights.
faq.voiceQ: So where does the brand voice come from?
faq.voiceA: From the brand guide, briefing, reference notes, and formats you ask to repeat. The more that is filled in, the more the copy sounds like the brand.
faq.quotaQ: Do I need an extra key (OpenAI, Gemini, Tavily) to use AI?
faq.quotaA: Copy uses the key you saved or the platform quota, depending on the plan. Web search works without an extra account; a Tavily key is optional for more stable search, and it is not a SOM account.
